in_marathi.name: Yatinraaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yatinraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Yatinraaj is the name of the charioteer of Lord Indra, the god of rain and thunder. He is considered the deity of wisdom and is believed to guide and protect the devotees on their spiritual journey. Yatinraaj is a revered figure in Hindu culture, especially among those seeking knowledge and wisdom.
